read-ai-pricing.0: Read AI pricing is easy to read and easy to underestimate. Free looks like a full product, then stops at 5 meetings. Annual billing knocks off 25%, which matters a lot at team scale. And the Enterprise tier has a 5-license minimum.
read-ai-pricing.1: In this Read AI pricing guide: what each plan costs, what it includes, and what a real team will pay in a year.
read-ai-pricing.2: Read AI costs $0 on Free, $19.75 per user per month on Pro with monthly billing, and $15 per user per month on Pro with annual billing. Above that, Enterprise and Enterprise+ cost more and add security and admin features.
read-ai-pricing.3: Prices are in USD, per user per month. Pay yearly and every paid plan drops 25%.
read-ai-pricing.4: Yes, Read AI has a free plan, but it covers only 5 meeting transcripts, 5 meeting reports and 5 live-note sessions a month, each up to 1 hour. Uploading files? Not on Free.
read-ai-pricing.6: Five meetings a month suits someone testing Read AI on their most important calls. Daily meetings? You will hit the limit in the first week.
read-ai-pricing.7: At $15 billed yearly or $19.75 monthly, Read AI Pro removes the meeting cap and adds 4 things: unlimited transcripts, priority report processing, 100 file upload credits a month, and meetings up to 4 hours long.
read-ai-pricing.10: Enterprise ($22.50 yearly, $29.75 monthly) adds audio and video playback, video highlights, 200 file upload credits a month and premium support. Minimum: 5 licenses.
read-ai-pricing.11: On top of that, Enterprise+ ($29.75 yearly, $39.75 monthly) adds compliance and identity features:
read-ai-pricing.12: One oddity: the pricing page lists different maximum meeting lengths for Enterprise in different places (4 hours in the table, 8 hours in the plan card). Long meetings matter to you? Confirm the limit with Read AI's sales team.
read-ai-pricing.13: A 10-person team pays $1,800 a year on Pro with annual billing, or $2,370 on monthly billing. For the same team, Enterprise costs $2,700 a year billed yearly. Here is how Read AI pricing scales.
read-ai-pricing.14: Small team that needs HIPAA? Check with Read AI, because Enterprise+ for 1 to 4 users is not listed as a separate case on the page.
read-ai-pricing.15: Most people should choose between 2 options: Free if you record 5 or fewer meetings a month, and Pro at $15 billed yearly if you record more. The Enterprise tiers? Only when a buyer, IT team or compliance rule requires them.
read-ai-pricing.16: On the fence between monthly and annual Pro? Start monthly for 1 or 2 months, then switch to annual once you know the team uses it and let the 25% saving kick in.
read-ai-pricing.18: Count the time spent after each meeting, too. When people still write follow-up emails and tickets by hand, the tool's price is only part of the cost.
read-ai-pricing.20: Calendar access is how Read AI joins meetings. When someone connects their calendar and auto-join is on, the notetaker can join meetings on that calendar, including meetings other people organized. A settings question, not a hidden cost. Still, it affects how many seats teams end up buying.
read-ai-pricing.22: Notetaker joining calls you organize without an invite? Ask the bot's owner to change their auto-join settings, or remove it from the participant list.
read-ai-pricing.23: Schools and universities get a separate [educational pricing page](https://www.read.ai/edu-pricing). As of 17 October 2026, the main pricing page lists no nonprofit discount and no India-specific prices; everything is shown in USD.
read-ai-pricing.24: Nonprofit, or based outside the US? Ask Read AI's sales team before buying. Some vendors adjust prices at checkout based on region or card.
read-ai-pricing.25: Read AI is worth the price if you value meeting analytics (engagement, talk time, coaching) and want one tool across Zoom, Google Meet and Teams with apps on every platform. Less so if you mainly need follow-up work done, or only meet a few times a week.
read-ai-pricing.27: Read AI Pro at $15 billed yearly sits in the middle of the market. Cheaper options: Otter Pro at $8.33 billed yearly, Fireflies Pro at $10 and Granola Business at $14.
read-ai-pricing.28: Lynkk (our product) costs $15 a month and focuses on the work around each meeting: a Meeting Brief before the call, Cue answers during it, and tasks with owners, a decision log and one-click Jira tickets after it. Ask Lynkk searches all your meetings and cites the exact source. On the free plan, you get up to 2 hours per note, versus 1 hour on Read AI Free.
read-ai-pricing.29: Full list: [Read AI alternatives](https://lynkk.ai/blog/read-ai-alternative) and [Read AI vs Otter AI](https://lynkk.ai/blog/read-ai-vs-otter-ai).
read-ai-pricing.31: Read AI Pro costs $19.75 per user per month on monthly billing, or $15 per month billed yearly. For Enterprise, it is $29.75 monthly or $22.50 yearly, and Enterprise+ runs $39.75 monthly or $29.75 yearly. With the 25% annual saving, a single Pro user pays $180 a year instead of $237.
read-ai-pricing.32: Yes. Read AI's free plan covers 5 meeting transcripts, 5 reports and 5 live-note sessions a month, each up to 1 hour long, with no file uploads. That suits testing Read AI on your most important calls; anyone with daily meetings will hit the limit within the first week.
read-ai-pricing.33: Yes. Teams pay per user, so a 10-person team pays $1,800 a year on Pro with annual billing, or $2,370 with monthly billing. Enterprise needs at least 5 licenses. For the same 10 people it costs $2,700 billed yearly and adds audio and video playback.
read-ai-pricing.34: Read AI Enterprise costs $22.50 per user per month billed yearly or $29.75 monthly, with a 5-license minimum. Enterprise+ runs $29.75 yearly or $39.75 monthly. Even a team of 3 that wants Enterprise features pays for 5 seats, so small teams usually stay on Pro.
read-ai-pricing.35: No. Otter Pro costs $8.33 a month billed yearly, compared with $15 for Read AI Pro. Monthly, it is $16.99 against $19.75. The free plans differ too: Otter gives 300 minutes a month at 30 minutes per call, while Read AI gives 5 meetings at up to 1 hour.
read-ai-pricing.36: Yes. Annual billing saves 25% on every paid plan. Pro drops from $19.75 to $15 per user per month, Enterprise from $29.75 to $22.50, and Enterprise+ from $39.75 to $29.75. Unsure? Start monthly for 1 or 2 months, then switch to annual once your team is clearly using it.
